lines.en: It was Sunday. I never get up early on Sundays. I sometimes stay in bed until lunchtime. Last Sunday I got up very late.
lines.zh: 那是个星期天，而在星期天我是从来不早起的，有时我要一直躺到吃午饭的时候。

lines.en: I looked out of the window.
lines.zh: 上个星期天，我起得很晚。
我望望窗外，外面一片昏暗。

lines.en: ‘I've just arrived by train, ’ she said.
lines.zh: “我刚下火车，”她说，“我这就来看你。

lines.en: ’ ‘But I'm still having breakfast, ’ I said.
‘I'm having breakfast, ’ I repeated ‘Dear me, ’ she said.
lines.zh: “我正在吃早饭，”我又说了一遍。

lines.en: ‘Do you always get up so late?
lines.zh: “天啊，”她说，“你总是起得这么晚吗？
